start_quiz_card_body: Take our updated safety quiz to start.
quiz_success_body: All safety checks passed. Your donor profile is active and you can now pledge.
quiz_fail_body: Medical safety guidelines say you should not donate blood right now.

quiz.q1: Are you at least 18 years old?
quiz.q1_desc: To donate blood, you must be 18 years or older for your health and safety.
quiz.q2: Do you weigh 50 kg or more?
quiz.q2_desc: You must weigh at least 50 kg so that you do not feel dizzy after donating blood.
quiz.q3: In the last 12 months, did you get a tattoo, piercing, or have surgery?
quiz.q3_desc: We ask this to prevent infections. Choose NO if you did not get any tattoos or surgery recently.
quiz.q4: Have you consumed alcohol or smoked in the past 24 hours?
quiz.q4_desc: You must not consume alcohol or smoke heavily before donating to protect blood quality.
quiz.q5: Are you feeling healthy and well today?
quiz.q5_desc: You should not donate if you currently have an active cold, sore throat, or cough.
quiz.q6: Are you currently taking antibiotics or other medications for an infection?
quiz.q6_desc: Active infections or antibiotic use temporarily disqualifies you from donating whole blood.
quiz.q7: Have you taken aspirin or drugs containing aspirin in the past 48 hours?
quiz.q7_desc: Aspirin affects blood platelets. Choose NO if you have not had aspirin in the past 2 days.
quiz.q8: Have you had any vaccinations or shots in the last 4 weeks?
quiz.q8_desc: Certain immunizations require a temporary deferral period before blood donation.
quiz.success_body: All safety checks passed. Your donor profile is active and you can now pledge to donate blood to hospital requests near you.
quiz.fail_body: Medical safety guidelines say you should not donate blood right now. For your security and health, please try testing again later.
